I couldn't confirm or rule out the 8 April renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co. I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team, and the date is still treated as unverified.

I looked only at what Pree can see herself: the shared files and the #central-team channel. None of them mention Brackenwater at all. There's no contract, CRM record or earlier message about it, so I have nothing to check the date against.

In the reply I suggested checking it against the signed contract or with whoever owns the account before anyone plans around it. I also offered to help follow up if she can tell me who owns Brackenwater or where its paperwork is kept.
